title: Add new user verification process with existing users as admins

requirements.text: Add a pending verification state to the user profile model in the backend. When a new user completes profile setup, their account status must be set to 'pending' until approved by an existing verified user.

quotes: Create a verification process for new users with the old users acting as admin

acceptanceCriteria: New user profiles are created with a 'pending' status by default
Existing users who were registered before this feature are automatically assigned 'verified' status
Backend stores and exposes user status (pending, verified, rejected) on the profile record

requirements.text: Add backend functions for admin (verified) users to list all pending users, approve a pending user (set status to 'verified'), and reject a pending user (set status to 'rejected'). Only verified users may call these functions.

quotes: Create a verification process for new users with the old users acting as admin

acceptanceCriteria: A `getPendingUsers()` function returns all users with 'pending' status, callable only by verified users
An `approveUser(userId)` function sets a user's status to 'verified', callable only by verified users
A `rejectUser(userId)` function sets a user's status to 'rejected', callable only by verified users
Calls from non-verified users to admin functions return an authorization error

requirements.text: Block access to the dashboard for users whose account status is 'pending' or 'rejected'. Show a dedicated waiting screen for pending users explaining that their account is awaiting admin approval, and a rejection notice for rejected users.

quotes: Create a verification process for new users with the old users acting as admin

acceptanceCriteria: After profile setup, a pending user sees a 'Waiting for Approval' screen instead of the dashboard
The waiting screen displays a clear message that an existing farm member must approve their account
A rejected user sees a rejection notice explaining they were not approved
Verified users continue to see the full dashboard as before

requirements.text: Add a 'User Verification' admin panel accessible only to verified users in the dashboard. This panel lists all pending users with their name and registration date, and provides Approve and Reject action buttons for each.

quotes: Create a verification process for new users with the old users acting as admin

acceptanceCriteria: A new 'Verification' tab or section appears in the dashboard only for verified users
The panel lists all pending users showing their display name and registration timestamp
Each pending user entry has an 'Approve' and a 'Reject' button
Approving or rejecting a user updates their status immediately and refreshes the list
The panel shows an empty state message when there are no pending users

requirements.text: Write a migration to mark all existing registered users as 'verified' so they retain full access after the verification feature is deployed.

quotes: with the old users acting as admin

acceptanceCriteria: All user profiles that existed before this upgrade have their status set to 'verified' after migration
No existing user loses access to the dashboard after deployment

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor (backend/main.mo)
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
Existing verified users must not lose any access or functionality
nonGoals: Email or push notification to admins when a new user registers
Role hierarchy beyond verified/pending/rejected (no separate super-admin role)
Time-limited verification tokens or invite links
